ImageDescription.value: A panorama taken from a viewpoint at the promontory Dyrhólaey in southern Iceland, looking inland. It shows the glacier Mýrdalsjökull in the center background, the mountain Reynisfjall and the beach of Reynisfjara to the right, with the sea stacks of Reynisdrangar at the extreme right. In front of Reynisfjall the lagoon of Dyrhólaós is visible. To the left, in the background, the glacier Eyjafjallajökull can be seen. In front of it the hill Pétursey is visible.
